editing_matrix.persistence_behavior: Autosave or manual save retains version, provenance, and safe drafts through offline work, sign-in, media failure, retry, and publishing interruption.
editing_matrix.undo_redo_behavior: Preserve native text undo/redo and bounded editorial undo across paste, formatting, annotations, and metadata without rewriting newer collaborative changes.
editing_matrix.conflict_behavior: Detect concurrent editorial, translation, or publishing conflict and offer version compare, keep, merge, reload, or fork while preserving both sources.
editing_matrix.read_only_disabled_behavior: Keep read-only published content selectable and semantically complete, disable unavailable editorial actions, and explain permission, lock, or publishing prerequisites.
editing_matrix.submission_behavior: Separate newline, search, comment, save draft, schedule, and publish actions; prevent duplicate submission and accept only the authoritative version response.

data_state_matrix.surface: Content article, documentation, or media region
data_state_matrix.data_condition: Primary content, a section, search result, or media asset is absent.
data_state_matrix.expectation: Preserve semantic structure, explain whether content is unpublished, filtered, removed, or unavailable, and offer a meaningful navigation or recovery action.

data_state_matrix.data_condition: Representative long-form content, media, links, annotations, code, and tables are present.
data_state_matrix.expectation: Maintain reading measure, heading hierarchy, citation relationships, link clarity, media meaning, and stable reading position.

data_state_matrix.data_condition: Translation expansion, long unbroken values, nested lists, wide tables, code, callouts, footnotes, and multiple media assets stress the layout.
data_state_matrix.expectation: Reflow without overlap, silent truncation, semantic reordering, orphaned captions, or page-level horizontal scrolling outside intrinsically wide bounded regions.

data_state_matrix.data_condition: Permission, remote source, embed, media, translation, or publishing state prevents the intended content from loading.
data_state_matrix.expectation: Provide accessible fallback meaning and provenance, retain the surrounding reading context, and expose retry, source, permission, or navigation recovery when valid.

semantics: lists, tables, code, quotations, notes, and citations
accessibility_matrix.reading_order: Source order follows the intended narrative and relationship order independent of columns, floats, sticky navigation, or print composition.
accessibility_matrix.focus_order: Focus follows interactive content in reading order, skip links reach major regions, and returning from notes, media, or disclosures restores the prior reading anchor.
keyboard: All links, disclosures, media controls, tables, annotations, and navigation are keyboard operable.
Provide a non-drag and non-hover path to every detail and relationship.
announcements: Announce expanded state, search result counts, loading or missing media, and asynchronous content changes without resetting reading position.
Keep decorative material silent and expose meaningful captions, credits, and alternatives once.
accessibility_matrix.target_size: Interactive content meets WCAG 2.2 AA target-size requirements of at least 24x24 CSS px or a documented spacing exception.
accessibility_matrix.contrast: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA for body text, large text, links, focus, code, annotations, and media overlays in every supported mode and print output.
accessibility_matrix.zoom_reflow: Reflow at 400% zoom and 200% text size with a readable line measure and no two-dimensional page scrolling except bounded tables, diagrams, or code.
alternatives: Provide concise alt text or a nearby long description for meaningful images, diagrams, audio, and video.
Provide transcripts, captions, text equivalents, and non-color link or status distinctions where applicable.

navigation_matrix.surface: Content hierarchy, links, search, citations, and reading history
navigation_matrix.entry: Site or document navigation, search result, external citation, shared URL, table of contents, or restored reading history.
navigation_matrix.destination: The intended authorized document, heading, note, media item, search match, or citation with context visible.
navigation_matrix.trigger: Pointer or keyboard link activation, heading navigation, search selection, print reference, or validated deep link.
navigation_matrix.back_behavior: Return to the prior search result, citation origin, note anchor, or reading position instead of merely resetting to the top of the document.
navigation_matrix.deep_link_behavior: Resolve a stable canonical URL and fragment to the intended content; when moved, expired, or inaccessible, explain the state and offer the nearest valid source or navigation path.
navigation_matrix.interruption_recovery: After refresh, mode change, print preview, sign-in, media failure, or external navigation, restore the reader's safe anchor, expanded state, and applicable preferences.

content_matrix.purpose: Help the reader understand, verify, and act on the content with a coherent editorial hierarchy.
content_matrix.copy: Use descriptive headings, explicit link purpose, consistent terminology, concise introductions, and examples sized to the audience's context.
content_matrix.primary_action: Keep any subscribe, continue, edit, download, or follow-up action subordinate to understanding and label it by outcome.
content_matrix.trust_requirement: Show author or owner, publication and update date, source or citation, scope, version, and material limitations where they affect interpretation.
content_matrix.localization: Support right-to-left flow, locale dates and numbers, translation expansion, vertical or non-Latin scripts where applicable, and language metadata for assistive technology.
content_limits: Keep primary reading measure roughly 45–80 characters while allowing headings and code to use appropriate bounds.
Never truncate citations, warnings, legal qualifiers, or the only distinguishing portion of a link or heading.

content_matrix.surface: Media, table, code, annotation, and fallback content
content_matrix.purpose: Preserve meaning and provenance when content is intrinsically wide, interactive, translated, printed, or missing.
content_matrix.copy: Pair complex assets with concise context, caption, credit, and an alternative that communicates the same essential information.
content_matrix.primary_action: Offer view full size, inspect data, read transcript, download accessible format, retry, or visit source only when safe and meaningful.
content_matrix.trust_requirement: Identify modification, generation, source, licensing, uncertainty, and missing-data boundaries that could change interpretation.
content_matrix.localization: Keep captions, credits, alt text, table headers, code direction, units, and annotation relationships correct across locale and print flow.
content_limits: Use bounded horizontal scrolling for intrinsically wide tables or code while keeping labels and headers associated.
Do not use decorative fallback text as a substitute for the missing asset's meaning.

motion_contract.purpose: Use minimal motion to preserve reading position and reveal content relationships without distracting from comprehension.

transitions.surface: Content disclosures, anchored navigation, media, and asynchronous inserts
transitions.trigger: Open or close related content, move to an anchor, load media, or insert an updated region.
transitions.response: Preserve the reading anchor and make the changed relationship perceivable without auto-playing, prolonged travel, or unexpected layout shift.
transitions.interrupt_behavior: New navigation, scrolling, search, or reduced-motion preference immediately cancels travel and lands at the correct stable content and focus state.

motion_contract.reduced_motion: Use direct anchor placement, static disclosure, and persistent status text; disable smooth travel, parallax, auto-play, and nonessential transition effects.

methods: target-user comprehension and findability session with long, translated, and complex content
critical_tasks: Find and understand the intended section from navigation, search, or a deep link.
Interpret a complex media, table, citation, or code example using its accessible alternative.
Recover reading context after missing content, external navigation, print, zoom, or locale change.
success_criteria: Readers find the target information and accurately explain its conclusion and limitations.
Heading, link, media, table, and citation relationships remain understandable through keyboard and assistive technology.
Zoom, localization, print, and fallback states preserve content meaning, provenance, and reading position.

targets.label: narrow reading surface
targets.adaptation: Typography, tables, media, and navigation remain readable without horizontal page scrolling.
targets.stretch_behavior: Reflow headings, media, callouts, and navigation continuously while preserving reading order and text scale.
targets.overflow_behavior: Wrap text and use bounded scrolling only for intrinsically wide content such as tables or code.

targets.label: primary reading surface
targets.adaptation: The approved reading measure and hierarchy remain stable with representative long-form content.
targets.stretch_behavior: Keep the approved reading measure stable as surrounding space changes and retain the reader's scroll anchor.
targets.overflow_behavior: Constrain media, tables, annotations, and long values without widening the primary reading column.

targets.label: wide content surface
targets.adaptation: Context and navigation may expand while the reading measure and media relationship stay fixed.
targets.stretch_behavior: Use surplus width for approved navigation or context while keeping measure, hierarchy, and media alignment stable.
targets.overflow_behavior: Keep wide contextual regions bounded and independently scrollable so they cannot distort the reading surface.

profiles.label: No user-visible presentation
profiles.summary: Headless services, libraries, data pipelines, infrastructure, and other work with no user-visible presentation surface.
profiles.exit_contract: Record design_system_status as not-applicable with current evidence, then skip preview, approval, handoff, ui-target, and visual-comparison work.
